linhas.en:
Archer's second SG.
It refers to the mentality of devotion towards others.
It could also be called the self-sacrifice of
putting other people's happiness before their own.

When the holder of this SG becomes a husband,
they'll surely be more than capable at working.

             ◆

You could say it's devotion similar to the way of chivalry,
but its true nature is different. In this case, service
isn't rendered to specific individuals but society itself.

What lies at its end is the vanishing of individuality.
Becoming a faceless upholder of social justice,
treated as an instrument rather than a person,
and so met a fitting end.
